_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - a shape to adapt, not a file to copy. It lives in port/ because VS Code's hook file path is NOT verified: the hook surface is documented as preview and no repository-level path could be confirmed. Find the real path in your harness's own documentation and place it there. Hook JSON is not portable: event names, payloads and failure semantics differ per harness.
_brief_is_a_stub: `python scripts/contextctl.py brief` is a STUB: it writes no digest, compares none, prints one message to stderr and exits 0, so this sessionStart entry runs cleanly and changes nothing. Wire it as written and replace the command when a renderer exists (see port/hooks/README.md).
_intent: sessionStart -> regenerate the digest a new session would read, so it is never the stale copy
agentStop -> check --all --warn: every finding surfaces as a message, nothing blocks the turn. A stop event cannot undo work that already ran, and a blocked turn is an outage
never auto-commit a generated digest: the check exists to make a missing handoff visible
whether anything DOES block is a config decision, not a decision for this file
